'''2022 MPC Edward Chien LS LEGEND''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Edward Chien]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Edward Chien]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Galaxy May Need A Legend / We Need Luke Skywalker|V11-L-thegalaxymayneedalegend.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open The Galaxy May Need A Legend Chien.txt |Download]]
